extracted.name: Strawberry smoothie
extracted.description: Get your fruit fix with our strawberry smoothie made with banana and orange juice. It's free from dairy, so it's vegan too – making it a great start to anyone's day
instruction_lines: Blitz the strawberries in a blender with the banana and orange juice until smooth.
Pour the smoothie into a tall glass to serve.
